translations.english: "Exuberant Rama and Lakshmana, highly brilliant Vibheeshana, and Sugriva who resembles Indra in his valour, are like rulers of the world and are heroic, wielders of weapons and bulls among men. If all four of them come together there in that manner, they will unearth the arch ways and even the city of Lanka. They are capable even if the Vanaras are kept away."
translations.hindi: थे चार अकेले ही परकोटों और तोरणद्वारों सहित लङ्का को उखाड़ कर फेंक सकते हें ॥ आप समस्त वानर भले ही बैठे रहें
